title: Incipit (Does Not Copy)
summary: An illuminated medieval capital rebuilt as a CSS pseudo-element, so its gold lives only in the render and never travels with the copied text.
mechanism: CSS ::first-letter / initial-letter illuminates the opening glyph but adds no character to the document; per-visit crypto.getRandomValues palette held only in RAM, so the copy carries plain letters and the aura stays on the glass.
references: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
